text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا

words.gloss_range: emphatic opening particle that anchors the full reward assertion
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) launches an emphatic reward declaration, not a loose continuation. Its scope reaches across the relative group and the reward predicate, and the assertion remains open for the no-transfer completion in 18:108. At the boundary after 18:106, the same firmness reverses the register from recompense for rejection to promised reception; the shaddah and compressed sound make that assertion feel audibly tight.

topics.headline: emphatic assertion governs the reward clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reward is not loosely appended; the emphatic particle governs the believer description and reward predicate, with its force continuing into the no-transfer completion in 18:108.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with the attachment evidence: the full clause from the relative subject through the reward predicate is the assertion governed by the emphatic particle.

topics.headline: contrastive boundary turns verdict into assurance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening assertion as a register reversal from condemnation into assured reward after 18:106.
topics.reason: The boundary and discourse rows are supported by the asyndetic opening and by the prior recompense frame in 18:106.

topics.headline: geminated sound compresses the assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the written and recited firmness of the particle suits the certainty of the reward claim.
topics.reason: The form rows concern the shaddah and compressed sound of the particle and do not alter the syntax.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun defining the reward recipients by description
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the reward recipients definite by description: the ayah first says which people, then lets belief and sound deeds fill the class. That keeps the reward from being generic. It also preserves the boundary reversal from 18:106, because another third-person group is now in view, but the evaluation has turned from condemnation to qualification.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the rewarded class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the beneficiaries are defined by the following predicates before their reward is named.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the governed subject of the emphatic particle, and its following verbs supply the qualifying description.

topics.headline: the described group replaces the condemned class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the evaluative reversal: a third-person class remains in view, but its description shifts from condemned rejecters to qualified believers.
topics.reason: The boundary rows are coherent with the preceding condemnation and the new relative description in the current ayah.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect plural belief/trust verb in a coordinated reward qualification
words.root_gloss_range: root field of safety, security, trust, belief, and granting safety; local Form IV selects trust-belief while protection and giving-safety remain associated pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) gives the relative group its first qualification as an established act of trust. The root field matters: locally the Form IV verb selects belief or trust-commitment, while the wider safety field, including the branch of granting safety, makes the later protected-garden reward feel lexically prepared rather than accidental. Because this verb is paired with the following action verb, the ayah enters the familiar belief-and-sound-deeds reward formula, echoing the same-surah reward frame in 18:30.

topics.headline: perfect plural belief qualifies the relative group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices belief as an established qualifier carried by the whole relative class, not as a new isolated event.
topics.reason: The perfect plural verb is controlled by the relative pronoun and opens the relative clause qualification.

topics.headline: trust is selected while security remains audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears belief as trust-commitment, while the root field of safety, protection, and granting safety prepares the protected-garden payoff.
topics.reason: Form IV and the objectless frame select trust or belief locally; broader giving-safety and seeking-protection branches are background pressure, not the local predication.

topics.headline: faith begins the reward formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the reward genre: belief is paired with doing sound deeds as a familiar Quranic qualification formula.
topics.reason: Distribution and formula rows match the local coordination with the action verb and sound-deeds object, including the recurrence from 18:30.

topics.headline: trust answers mockery and offense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the response to the preceding scene is not another sign-display but the named stance of trust.
topics.reason: The boundary rows preserve the contrast between prior mockery/rejection and the current qualifying trust.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the two qualification verbs
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins belief to action without turning the second verb into a separate launch or a strictly later step. The connector lets the qualification move from inner trust to outward work while holding both together as one rewarded profile. Its light proclitic sound also keeps the movement fused to the next verb.

topics.headline: waw coordinates without forcing sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief and action are joined without a forced before-after sequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the two verbs and does not mark a causal or sequential particle.

topics.headline: connector joins trust to performed work
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause pivot from inward trust to outward action while keeping both in one qualification.
topics.reason: The structural rows are supported by the local coordination of the two perfect verbs in the relative clause.

topics.headline: weak connector fuses to the next verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a light join rather than a heavy new clause break before the action verb.
topics.reason: The sound row is consistent with the proclitic conjunction attached to the following verb.

words.gloss_range: coordinated Form I perfect plural action verb with an explicit definite object
words.root_gloss_range: root range of working, doing, and producing; local object narrows it to deliberate performance of sound deeds

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite sound-deeds object governed by the action verb

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) carries the qualification outward into performed work. It is coordinated with the belief verb and takes {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) as its object, so the action is not generic busyness but deliberate work measured by the recognized deed-class. The plural perfect ending matches the earlier verb, making belief and work a paired cadence; same-surah links with 18:88 and 18:110 keep this reward formula active.

topics.headline: second perfect verb takes the sound-deeds object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that action is not vague activity; it is a coordinated transitive verb aimed at a definite object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the verb coordinated with belief and taking the following sound-deeds noun as its object.

topics.headline: deliberate work is selected over generic doing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees performed output and deliberate production, while the local object keeps the sense from expanding into every possible kind of action.
topics.reason: The root rows distinguish purposeful work from generic doing; local grammar narrows it to doing the sound-deeds object.

topics.headline: work completes the faith-action formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that the action verb binds faith to the soundness root in a formulaic reward marker.
topics.reason: The distribution rows are supported by the local collocation with belief and the following sound-deeds object, including same-surah links at 18:88 and 18:110.

topics.headline: plural perfect cadence matches belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the two plural perfect verbs as a paired qualification beat.
topics.reason: Plural suffix and cadence rows cohere with the shared relative subject and the coordinated verb pair.

words.gloss_range: definite plural active-participle substantive functioning as the object of doing
words.root_gloss_range: root range of repair, soundness, reconciliation, and righteousness; local form selects recognized sound deeds
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) closes the qualification by naming the standard that the action takes as its object. The active-participle form turns soundness into a deed-class, and the definite article makes that class recognized. The root’s repair and soundness pressure remains useful: these are deeds whose quality is sound and restorative, not merely deeds that happen to be religiously labeled. With belief and work, the phrase restores the full reward formula seen elsewhere, including 18:30.

topics.headline: definite substantive names the deed standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is specified by a known class of deeds, not left open-ended.
topics.reason: The noun is the object of the action verb, and its article plus plural substantive form mark a recognized deed category.

topics.headline: repair-root soundness measures the deeds
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees righteousness as soundness and restoration embodied in deeds, while local grammar selects the established righteous-deeds expression.
topics.reason: The repair and soundness root field survives as semantic pressure, but the local active-participle substantive narrows it to deed quality.

topics.headline: sound deeds complete the reward formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the complete formula of belief, work, and sound deeds as the qualification for reward.
topics.reason: The distribution rows fit the local faith-work-soundness sequence and same-surah reward scenes.

topics.headline: article assimilation fuses sound and standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the article fused into the initial consonant, matching the word’s role as a familiar fixed standard.
topics.reason: The sound row concerns sun-letter assimilation and is compatible with the definite form.

words.gloss_range: perfect feminine singular copular/existential verb opening the reward predicate
words.root_gloss_range: root range of being, becoming, existence, and formation; local perfect predicate selects established reward-being
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَتْ}} ({{tr:kānat}}) pivots from qualification to allocation. The perfect form presents the reward as established within the assertion, while the feminine suffix anticipates the delayed plural gardens. The k-w-n range remains felt as existence and becoming, but local grammar narrows it to established predication: the gardens are assigned as a reality for the described people. Same-surah echoes with transient existence in 18:45 sharpen the contrast.

topics.headline: perfect being introduces the reward predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reward as already established in the declaration, even though it concerns eschatological reception.
topics.reason: The perfect copular verb begins the predicate content of the emphatic assertion and governs the beneficiary, subject, and final accusative field.

topics.headline: feminine singular anticipates delayed gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the delayed garden subject prepared before it appears, so the predicate opens with grammatical anticipation.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix agrees with the delayed nonhuman plural subject and is confirmed by attachment evidence.

topics.headline: existence field is selected as established allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses being, becoming, and existence behind the verb, while the perfect reward clause selects established being rather than an ongoing process.
topics.reason: The k-w-n range is broader than the local clause; the form and syntax narrow it to established predication/allocation.

topics.headline: existence language reverses earlier transient scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah reversal: transient being and descent scenes are answered by established reward existence.
topics.reason: The echo rows connect the current k-w-n predication with 18:45 and other same-surah reality claims without controlling the parse.

topics.headline: verb turns qualification into allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah pivot from who the people are to what has been assigned to them.
topics.reason: The verb opens the reward declaration after the relative qualification and combines with the fronted beneficiary phrase.

words.gloss_range: fronted prepositional lām of possession, benefit, and allocation
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the fronted beneficiary phrase, placing allocation before the reward noun appears. Its force is not only ownership or only benefit; in this predicate it can hold possession, benefit, and dedication together. That means the ayah first marks the gardens as for them, then names what the assigned gift is.

topics.headline: fronted lām phrase scopes over the gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipients before the gift, so allocation is foregrounded before the gardens are named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the lām-pronoun phrase as the fronted predicate phrase under the reward verb.

topics.headline: preposition holds possession and benefit together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward as assigned for them, to their benefit, and in their possession without forcing only one English relation.
topics.reason: The semantic rows fit the local beneficiary predicate and do not contradict the grammar.

topics.headline: proclitic allocation fuses to the pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears allocation compressed into the pronoun before the garden noun arrives.
topics.reason: The form and sound rows concern the proclitic lām and the following pronoun.

words.gloss_range: third-person masculine plural pronoun governed by the allocation lām

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: allocation lām governing the recipient pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) compresses the whole qualified group into a short recipient marker. Governed by {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}), it keeps the reward personally assigned to the same people described by belief and sound deeds. Its fronted position holds the recipients before the gift, and the nasal closure lands just before the gardens are named.

topics.headline: attached pronoun resumes the qualified group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the full belief-and-action description is compressed into the beneficiary pronoun.
topics.reason: The pronoun is governed by the lām and resolves to the relative-clause recipients.

topics.headline: pronoun holds the reward slot before the gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the recipients held in front position while the garden reward is delayed.
topics.reason: The structural rows cohere with the fronted beneficiary phrase before the delayed subject.

topics.headline: nasal pronoun separates opposed recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the recipient marker close just before the garden noun opens, while the same pronoun shape contrasts with opposed recipients elsewhere in the boundary frame.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary rows add local cadence and contrast without changing reference.

words.gloss_range: plural garden noun as delayed subject and construct head before Firdaws
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes concealment, covering, garden, jinn, and madness; local plural construct selects protected gardens

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: genitive Firdaws name specifying the plural gardens

words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّٰتُ}} ({{tr:jannātu}}) is where the assigned reward becomes concrete. Grammatically it arrives after the beneficiary phrase as the delayed subject and immediately enters construct with {{ar:ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ}} ({{tr:al-firdawsi}}), so the gardens are named as a specified domain rather than a standalone image. The j-n-n root is narrowed to gardens here, but its concealment and protection pressure survives, especially when the next word adds Firdaws as an enclosing name.

topics.headline: plural gardens arrive as delayed subject in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gift appears after the beneficiary phrase and is immediately bound to a specifying genitive.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as the delayed subject of the reward verb and the construct head governing the following Firdaws name.

topics.headline: concealment root selects protected gardens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees garden reward as protected enclosure, while local form blocks unrelated jinn or madness branches.
topics.reason: The j-n-n root has multiple branches, but the plural construct garden noun locally selects gardens while retaining concealment/protection imagery.

topics.headline: plural construct multiplies spaces inside one domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices multiplicity: the reward is not a single garden but plural gardens specified by the Firdaws domain.
topics.reason: The plural construct rows fit the local iḍāfa and the following genitive proper name.

topics.headline: garden reward answers earlier scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees abstract recompense become concrete garden reward, with same-surah garden imagery returning as final reward.
topics.reason: The distribution and boundary rows connect the current noun to same-surah parable/reward patterns without changing the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: genitive proper foreign name specifying the preceding plural gardens
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ}} ({{tr:al-firdawsi}}) specifies the preceding plural gardens: first the ayah opens multiplicity, then it narrows the destination to Firdaws. The name is marked as foreign or arabicized, suggesting a destination-name that exceeds ordinary Arabic categories, yet the article and genitive position make it work inside Arabic grammar. Its walled enclosure, grapevine, and encompassing-garden associations thicken the protected-space image, and its rarity, echoed with believer reward in 23:11, gives the destination concentrated rank.

topics.headline: Firdaws narrows the garden class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: plural gardens open the image, then the genitive proper name specifies it as Firdaws.
topics.reason: The noun is the genitive dependent in the iḍāfa with the preceding gardens.

topics.headline: foreign-origin name is absorbed into Arabic grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an exceptional destination-name whose marked origin suggests more than an ordinary Arabic garden label while still functioning smoothly inside Arabic article and construct grammar.
topics.reason: The loanword and article rows are compatible: the marked name is arabicized in form and syntax here.

topics.headline: walled and encompassing garden image thickens the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Firdaws not merely as a label but as a walled, abundant, encompassing garden domain beside the concealment of gardens.
topics.reason: The etymological enclosure rows support the local image when joined to the preceding garden noun, while not replacing the proper-name function.

topics.headline: rare occurrence concentrates reward weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the rarity of the name, with its only supplied cross-surah echo in another believer-reward setting (23:11).
topics.reason: The distribution rows give only 18:107 and 23:11 for the name, both in reward contexts.

topics.headline: consonant texture marks the specific name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reward name become sonically distinct from the more common formula words around it.
topics.reason: The phonetic row adds texture to the proper name without changing the grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative reception/lodging noun closing the reward clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range of descent, sending down, dwelling, station, and guest provision; local noun selects prepared hospitality and arrival-reception
words.prose: {{ar:نُزُلًا}} ({{tr:nuzulā}}) is the ayah’s final landing, so the clause does not stop on the garden name alone; it stops on reception. The accusative can work as circumstance, specification, or predicate, letting the gardens serve as reception, be classified by reception, or complete the assertion as reception. Its indefiniteness and final tanwīn make reception a qualitative classification, and the accepted sukūn variant keeps the closing word as an audible pressure point without changing the meaning. The n-z-l root is narrowed to hospitality/lodging here, yet descent and arrival remain audible: Firdaws is the prepared place where the recipients arrive. That payoff is sharpened by the same word marking an opposite reception in 18:102 and by 18:108 turning arrival into no-transfer permanence.

topics.headline: final accusative supports manner, specification, or predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word can make the gardens serve as reception, specify them by reception, or complete the predicate as reception.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence explicitly licenses the circumstantial and additional-predicate readings, while the CRITICAL rows also preserve the specification reading.

topics.headline: hospitality noun keeps descent and arrival pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Firdaws as prepared guest-reception and arrival-station, while local usage selects hospitality/lodging rather than a bare descent event.
topics.reason: The n-z-l family includes descent, dwelling, station, and guest provision; the local noun and reward context narrow this to prepared reception while preserving arrival pressure.

topics.headline: indefinite accusative and variant make closure qualitative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears reception as a qualitative final classification, with accepted recitational variation exposing the closing word as a pressure point.
topics.reason: The tanwīn and qiraat rows concern form and sound while preserving the same local meaning.

topics.headline: same hospitality word splits opposed destinations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader catches the polarity: the same reception term used for Jahannam in 18:102 is now used for Firdaws in 18:107.
topics.reason: The same-surah rows supply concrete references and support a contrastive reception frame.

topics.headline: ayah lands on reception, not only on the garden name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause ends on hospitality, and 18:108 then turns that arrival-reception into no-transfer permanence.
topics.reason: The final-position and boundary rows are supported by word order and by the following ayah reference to no transfer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'believe and do the salihat' at focus words 3-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settled assent becomes deliberate action, while salihat specifies action that counters corruption; belief and work form one embodied repair pattern rather than two unrelated credentials.

activation_trace.role: Assent that settles the heart supplies the inward orientation of the pattern.
Intentional action carries the inward orientation into purposive practice.
Soundness opposed to corruption gives that practice its repairing criterion.

changed_reading.before: Belief and good deeds are two generic qualifications for reward.
changed_reading.after: Settled assent is embodied as intentional practice whose defining effect is repair rather than corruption.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate 'Gardens of al-Firdaws as nuzul' at focus words 6-10.
baseline_models.mechanism: Realized presence, tree-screened cultivation, and provision prepared for an arriving guest combine into a destination that receives and shelters, not merely a prize that is viewed or owned.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence supply the predicate's realized availability for them.
A garden screened by its trees supplies the cultivated destination.
Concealment from sense adds shelter to the cultivated space.
Provision prepared for a guest makes the Gardens an act of reception.

changed_reading.before: Paradise is a static prize possessed after belief and deeds.
changed_reading.after: A cultivated, sheltering domain is present for them as prepared reception on arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same guest-provision term names Hell's reception in 18:102 and the Gardens' reception in 18:107. Nuzul therefore marks an assigned arrival-reception whose moral quality comes from what has been prepared, not an intrinsically pleasant object.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest provision frames the focus destination as reception.
The ready-at-hand preparation makes the infernal reception deliberately appointed.
The identical guest-provision image applied to Hell removes automatic pleasantness from nuzul itself.

structural_cues: 18:102 and 18:107 both close with nuzulan, but their prepared destinations are Hell and the Gardens respectively.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical reception language and explicit preparation; I infer that nuzul is destination-neutral allotment at arrival. A live alternative is deliberate ironic reuse of an otherwise positive hospitality term.

changed_reading.before: Nuzul itself means a pleasant heavenly welcome.
changed_reading.after: Nuzul is the appointed reception at arrival; the Gardens, in contrast to Hell, determine that this reception shelters and delights.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence distinguishes purposeful effort and impressive craft from work that remains sound: effort can stray, seem good to its maker, collapse, and retain no weight. The focus adjective salihat thus carries a necessary criterion of objective soundness, not decorative praise.

activation_trace.role: Purposive action supplies the work being qualified in the focus.
Soundness against corruption supplies the condition that distinguishes durable work.
The same intentional-action domain becomes the announced site of greatest loss.
Purposeful movement toward a goal shows that direction and exertion alone do not secure arrival.
Doing what appears good supplies a positive appraisal that the verse can expose as mistaken.
Skilled handiwork makes technical competence an insufficient test of righteous action.
Falling and collapse picture the loss of standing suffered by their works.
Weight as worth or standing supplies the final evaluative test the failed works do not survive.

structural_cues: 18:103 announces loss in works; 18:104 gives wandering effort under self-approval; 18:105 says the works collapse and receive no weight.
The unqualified work sequence immediately precedes the focus pairing of work with salihat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed action, misdirected striving, favorable self-assessment, collapse, and weightlessness; I infer that salihat marks work capable of surviving that evaluation. Alternatively, the failure may arise wholly from denial rather than any defect visible in the works themselves.

changed_reading.before: Salihat merely praises deeds already identifiable as good by their performers.
changed_reading.after: Salihat marks intentional work whose orientation and integrity remain sound when self-assessment, apparent skill, and final weight diverge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's heart-settled belief is bracketed by taking substitute patrons apart from God and by the command to recognize one deity and admit no partner into worship. Belief consequently reads as an undivided placement of trust and allegiance, not assent left compatible with rival securities.

activation_trace.role: Security and heart-settled trust supply belief's relational center.
Acquiring or adopting supplies the deliberate installation of substitute patrons.
Near support and loyal alliance define what is wrongly sought from those patrons.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the exclusive center of reliance.
Partnership with God supplies the rejected division of allegiance.
Submissive worship makes allegiance practical rather than merely conceptual.
Exhaustive negation closes off every residual co-recipient of worship.

structural_cues: Taken guardians in 18:102 and one deity with no co-worshiper in 18:110 bracket the believers named in 18:107.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival patronage, divine oneness, and unshared worship; I map these onto AMN's security-and-trust branch as the placement of reliance. The narrower alternative is that the context regulates worship only, without extending the focus verb to affective security.

changed_reading.before: Those who believe are people who assent to a proposition.
changed_reading.after: Those who believe settle security and allegiance in one divine center rather than distributing them among adopted patrons.

context_deltas.mechanism: What nuzul can present as provision for an arriving guest is immediately made permanent: the recipients adhere there and do not seek any transfer. Arrival-hospitality is therefore not a temporary staging point but an endlessly fitting mode of residence.

activation_trace.role: Guest provision supplies the initial welcome whose duration is at issue.
Persistence resistant to decay extends the welcome without terminal loss.
Seeking supplies the desire that is explicitly absent.
Change from one state or place supplies the transfer they never seek.

structural_cues: 18:108 directly continues the Garden destination with abiding there and no desire for transfer away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guest provision, permanence, and absent desire for relocation; I infer that welcome has become settled belonging. Alternatively, nuzul may already denote provision without implying a short stay, so the context confirms rather than overturns it.

changed_reading.before: The Gardens are an initial welcome before some further or more settled destination.
changed_reading.after: The initial welcome is itself permanent home: reception remains satisfying enough that no onward transfer is wanted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse repeats 'do/work a salih work' while placing it under hope of meeting the Lord. This gives the focus practice a telos: its soundness is fitness for encounter, not merely social usefulness or visible product.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies the practice whose purpose is sharpened.
Fitness and suitability make the practice apt for an end beyond itself.
The heart's expectancy supplies the forward orientation of the work.
Two parties coming face to face supplies the anticipated encounter.
The repeated verb-and-noun action construction explicitly resumes the focus's practice.
Repeated fitness qualifies that work in relation to the hoped-for meeting.

structural_cues: 18:110 restates the focus collocation as a singular imperative after naming hope for meeting the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact work-salih recurrence governed by hoped-for meeting; I infer that encounter is the work's orienting end, not that work mechanically purchases it. A live alternative is that 18:110 simply summarizes admission criteria without redefining salih.

changed_reading.before: Righteous work is beneficial conduct considered only by its present effects.
changed_reading.after: Righteous work is intentional practice made fit for the hoped-for face-to-face encounter to which the recipient is moving.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses KFR, GTW, and JNN and treats covering as a material analogy rather than an etymology. It remains anchored in the focus garden's concealment and tree-cover branches. Downstream prose should call it a contrastive image, not claim that the roots are lexically equivalent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Jannat at focus word 8, whose inventory joins concealment with a garden screened by trees.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the garden's capacity to shelter.
Tree cover turns concealment into a living cultivated environment.
Covering that blocks truth supplies the negative pole of concealment.
A covering over perception makes occlusion concrete immediately before the focus.

changed_reading.before: The garden's cover is only a neutral physical description.
changed_reading.after: The sequence turns cover inside out: the cover that blocked truth and perception is contrasted with cultivated cover that shelters receptive believers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bridge is cross-domain: 18:109 literally makes divine words, not Garden provisions, inexhaustible. It remains anchored in nuzul as prepared provision and jannat as vigorous plant life. Downstream prose should present nondepleting hospitality as resonance or possibility, not as the direct assertion of 18:109.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Nuzul at focus word 10 and the living garden at word 8.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest provision supplies the finite-looking ration that the context can reopen.
Dense, vigorous plant growth supplies a regenerative image for the Garden.
Vast abundant water supplies the scale of the attempted writing resource.
Connected replenishment supplies an added resource that still cannot exhaust the source.
Meaningful words identify what is literally inexhaustible and thereby contain the analogy.
Failure by depletion supplies the limit that the divine words outlast.

changed_reading.before: Nuzul is a bounded welcome ration supplied once to each arrival.
changed_reading.after: The adjacent image permits an exploratory reading of the Garden's welcome as continually replenished hospitality rather than exhaustible stock.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading follows the less immediate reconciliation branch of SLH and the interpersonal-dealing branch of AML, so it should not replace the ordinary righteous-action reading. It remains focus-anchored through words 4-5 and the explicit guest-provision image at word 10. Render it as a social mechanism the branches permit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The relation between doing salihat at focus words 4-5 and receiving nuzul at word 10.

activation_trace.role: Dealing between people supplies an interpersonal field for the action.
Removing estrangement supplies reconciliation as one concrete kind of salih practice.
Receiving a guest supplies the social form of the promised destination.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds and heavenly hospitality have only a reward-to-action relation.
changed_reading.after: Practices that remove estrangement can be read as rehearsing the hospitable social order in which their doers are finally received.

strongest_changes: The infernal nuzul of 18:102 makes reception destination-neutral; the Gardens give the focus reception its positive content.
The failed-work sequence makes salihat a substantive criterion by which purposeful, impressive, self-approved work either keeps or loses standing.
The guardianship and no-partnership frame changes belief from bare assent into undivided reliance and enacted allegiance.
The immediate permanence clause turns arrival hospitality into settled home, while 18:110 orients sound work toward meeting the Lord.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses an entire passage-level mechanism into three pairings: trust with repairing action, cultivated concealment with reception, and arrival with permanence. The most productive surprise was that neither work nor nuzul is positive in isolation; each receives its value from qualification, orientation, and destination.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated nuzul may be a neutral reception category or an ironic transfer of hospitality language to Hell.
The failed works may lack weight because of their internal misorientation, because denial nullifies otherwise competent acts, or both.
The cover-reversal and inexhaustible-provision readings are branch-anchored but remain cross-root or cross-domain analogies.
Al-Firdaws has no focus branch inventory in the packet, so its specific contribution cannot be traced beyond the focus construction.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Sound work culminates in settled arrival.** `ء م ن` B001, `ع م ل` B001, and `ص ل ح` B001 repeat the opening promise, while `ن ز ل` B001’s descent/alighting image appears in `نزلًا` as prepared lodging. Worldly water descends and vanishes (18:45); here the workers themselves alight into a garden that endures (18:108). I infer a reversal from transient incoming provision to permanent received residence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:108 completed the promise by adding a will that no longer seeks transfer from its lodging.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Righteous work becomes fitting guest-provision.** `ن ز ل/B005` is prepared hospitality for a guest. Five ayat earlier, hell was `نُزُلًا` for those who took false patrons (18:102); 18:103–106 then distinguishes losing work, weightless manufacture, and mockery before this positive work–lodging relation. I infer that action configures what kind of reception fits the arriving person. The gardens read as prepared, sustaining hospitality rather than merely a prize-object.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:108 made the hospitality internally stable, and 18:109–110 tied that stability to inexhaustible words received as guidance and work.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalın kişiler arası barışma çekirdeğine dayanır ve başka dallardaki genel iyi olma, düzeltme veya uygunluk anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluk, uzaklık veya çatışmanın giderilerek tarafların karşılıklı biçimde barışması ve uzlaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Birbirinden uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış insanlar arasındaki olumsuz ilişki giderilir.
Taraflar karşılıklı olarak barışır ve aralarında uzlaşma oluşur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu anlamı insanların kendi aralarında barışması ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi olarak ortaklaşa verir; ad ve eylem biçimleri aynı karşılıklı uzlaşma olayını anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluğun veya çatışmanın giderilip karşılıklı barışın kurulmasını eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiler arası olumsuz ilişkinin giderilmesini ve tarafların karşılıklı uzlaşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Daha önce uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış tarafların yeniden iyi ilişki kurduğu bağlamlarda doğal bir açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki olumsuz ilişkiyi, bunun giderilmesini ve karşılıklı barışmayı birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın merkezinde kişiler arasındaki soğukluğun giderilmesi ve barışma süreci vardır; komşu dal ise bunu savaş karşıtı barış durumuna kadar genişletir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnızca barışma yönünü ve karşılıklı uzlaşmayı içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal taraflar arasında barışın yanı sıra düşmanlık kurma karşıt yönünü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: barışma ile ilişkiyi barışa veya düşmanlığa çevirme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanlar arasındaki ilişkinin barış yönünde kurulmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal karşılıklı barışma anlamında tek yönlüdür; komşu dal ise bir etkenin ilişkiyi barış ya da düşmanlık yönünde kurmasını içeren daha geniş ve ettirgen bir çerçevedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Soğukluğu giderme ve tarafları barış ilişkisine döndürme odak dala aittir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tarafları birbirine karşı kışkırtma ve aralarındaki ilişkiyi bozma komşu dala aittir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişiler veya gruplar arasındaki ilişkinin çatışma ile barış arasındaki yönünü değiştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çatışmayı sona erdirip yakınlaşma doğurur; komşu dal bunun tersine tarafları birbirine düşürüp çatışmayı başlatır veya artırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tarafların uzaklığı bırakıp yeniden iyi ilişki kurması odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tarafların birbirinden yüz çevirmesi, ilişkiyi kesmesi ve uzaklaşması komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişiler arasındaki yakınlık veya uzaklık durumunu ve ilişkinin sürmesini konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uzaklığı gidererek ilişkiyi yeniden kurar; komşu dal ilişkiyi keserek tarafları birbirinden uzaklaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bağımsız bir genel nitelik değil, belirli bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun ve onun alanından olması biçimindeki yapıya bağlı anlam verir. Geçici çerçeve uygunluk ilişkisini doğru saptamış ve ahlaki iyilik ya da bozukluğu düzeltme anlamlarını bu dala katmamıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun olduğunu bildiren kalıba bağlıdır; bu kullanım yalın kökün genel anlamı gibi genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir yapıda, bir şeyin bir kişiye uygun düşmesi, ona uyması ve onun alanından sayılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey ile yöneldiği kişi arasında uygunluk ve uyma ilişkisi bulunur.
Uygun görülen şey, kişinin alanına veya türüne ait sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı ifade, belirli bir şeyin muhataba uygun olduğunu onun alanından veya türünden sayılma açıklamasıyla verir; anlam bütünüyle bu kişi yönelimli yapıya bağlıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uyduğunu bildiren kaynak yapısının kişi yönelimli uygunluk ilişkisini karşılar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne, seçenek veya işin muhatabın alanına, durumuna ya da niteliğine uygun olduğu söylenirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir şeyin belirli bir kişiye uygun düşmesini doğal bir cümle içinde korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetiştirilen şeyin getirisi, bereketi veya artan payı anlatılırken kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bütün ağırlama payını, azığı ve bundan gelişen gelir ile bağış anlamlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal konuğa sunulan küçük ve belirli bir yiyecek ikramını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal konuğa sunulmak üzere hazırlanan yiyecek alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel hazırlık ve paydır; komşu dal bunun içindeki belirli, küçük bir ikram türüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yiyeceğin yanında konuğu, azığı, geliri ve bağışı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca yemeğin ağırlama payı bakımından çokluğunu niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bol ve konuk ağırlamaya elverişli yemek kullanımı iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yiyeceğin bolluk niteliğine sıkıca bağlıdır; odak dal hazırlanan payın kendisinden daha geniş bir anlam ailesi kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yiyeceğin özellikle konuk için önceden hazırlanmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel tat ve yedirmenin yanında yapı kurma veya evlenme vesilesiyle yemek vermeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yiyecek sunma ve başkasını doyurma alanı iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal konuk ağırlama amacına bağlı hazır paydır; komşu dal daha genel yedirme eylemi ve tören yemeğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gelen kişiye sunulacak yiyecek ve ağırlama payıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin kaldığı ev, durak ya da soyut derecedir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişinin bir yere gelip kalması senaryosu iki dalı aynı alanda buluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal konuğa sunulan hazırlığı, komşu dal ise konuğun kaldığı yeri veya konumu adlandırır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يهيأ للنزيل والضيف من طعام وزاد وضيافة، وما يسمى نزلا لأهل الجنة أو النار، والضيف نفسه بلفظ النزيل، والريع والفضل والعطاء إذا شبها بذلك.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النزل ما يهيأ للنزيل؛ طعام ذو نزل؛ النزيل الضيف (maqayis)؛ النزل ما يهيأ للقوم والضيف؛ النزل ريع ما يزرع (ayn)؛ النزل ما يهيأ للنزيل؛ النزل أيضا الريع؛ النزيل الضيف (sihah)؛ حسن النزل أي الضيافة؛ أنزال القوم أرزاقهم؛ أقمت لهم غذاءهم وما يصلح معه أن ينزلوا عليه؛ النزل الريع والفضل (tahdhib)؛ النزل ما يعد للنازل من الزاد؛ أنزلت فلانا أضفته؛ ذو نزل له ريع؛ حظ نزل مجتمع تشبيها بالطعام النزل (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النازلة والنوازل، أي الشدة التي تنزل بالقوم أو بالناس من شدائد الدهر.
يدخل فيه النزال والمنازلة في الحرب، وأن ينزل الفريقان معا للقتال، ولفظ نزال بمعنى انزلوا للحرب.
يدخل فيه قولهم نزل أو نزل القوم إذا أتوا منى، والتعبير عن الحج بالنزول.
يدخل فيه النزالة والنزل كناية عن ماء الرجل وخروجه، وقولهم أنزل ماءه والمرأة تستنزله.
يدخل فيه النزلة بمعنى المرة الواحدة من النزول، وتفسير نزلة أخرى بمرة أخرى، ومنه عند بعضهم النزلة كالزكام بوصفها عارضة.

branches.branch_image_ar: المكان الذي يظهر فيه أثر النزول
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أوصاف أرض نزلة ومكان نزل إذا أريد سرعة السيل من أدنى مطر، أو كثرة النزول به، أو أوصاف المكان الواسع البعيد أو المحلال المرب أو الضيق من الأودية.
